updates.метод: Single-clinic prospective SCS cohort; preoperative clinical, patient-reported and MRI radiomic variables linked to one-year NRS response. Models use KNN imputation and MinMax scaling, an 80/20 train_test_split, five stratified GridSearchCV folds and RFE feature selection. The article does not provide code, split seed or fold-scoped preprocessing details.
updates.датасет: 150 subjects with successful thoracic SCS trials enrolled November 2012-March 2019 and preoperative/one-year assessments; Supplemental Table 2 reports 89 nonresponders and 61 >50% responders, of whom 30 were >70% responders. Deidentified patient data are not public.
updates.ограничения: The publisher full text reports 150 subjects, one-year patient-linked outcomes, an 80/20 train/test split and five stratified GridSearchCV folds. It does not provide split seed, participant IDs, fold membership, code, independent external validation, calibration or public patient data. Methods prose describes MinMax scaling and KNN imputation before the split, but does not establish whether transforms were fitted within training folds; potential leakage is a concern, not a demonstrated execution error. RFE containment is also not specified. The 90% accuracies are author-reported internal results, not external clinical validation. No ECAP predictor is described.

evidence.population: 150 patients at one clinic with successful thoracic SCS trials and preoperative/one-year assessments; FBSS, CRPS, neuropathic or unspecified chronic pain are reported.
evidence.target_label: Separate binary one-year NRS reduction >50% responder and >70% high-responder targets; 61/150 and 30/150, respectively.

validation.notes: Official Ovid/LWW publisher PDF and Supplemental Table 2 reviewed on 2026-09-28. Methods pp. 896-897 define the single-clinic 150-subject cohort, preoperative measures paired with one-year NRS outcomes, 80/20 train_test_split, five stratified GridSearchCV folds and RFE. Table E976 gives 89/61 for >50% response and 120/30 for >70% response. Reported preprocessing order raises possible leakage; actual training-only fitting cannot be checked without code. Split seed/membership and external validation are unavailable; patient data are not public and code is on request.
